about: Findings of saved review sessions whose criteria pass, trimmed, with the results their commands gave and the lines of the cited file each case needs, at their line numbers (#1043). chunker-full-match (20261003-012555, S8) is false: PurePath.full_match exists on Python 3.13 and later. Both its verification criteria assert that skips_persona_review returns the right value, the opposite of the claim. S8 recorded them timed out at 5 s; the results are those of the offline replay at da50329, where both exited 0 (15.6 s and 15.2 s) and the finding ended VERIFIED by criteria. test-rag-indexing (20261003-012555) calls the test that spans the cited line as its invalidation criterion, which passed and refutes the claim. pipeline-protocol-masking (20260928-201857) calls the cited test as a verification criterion on a claim that the test is wrong, which a pass does not confirm; that session VERIFIED it by criteria.

finding.title: Undefined method call on PurePosixPath
finding.description: The function `skips_persona_review` uses `posix.full_match(pattern)`, but `PurePosixPath` (from `pathlib`) does not provide a `full_match` method. This causes an `AttributeError` at runtime whenever a diff block is processed and the skip logic is invoked. The error propagates up the call stack, potentially aborting the review-generation pipeline and causing a denial-of-service for users.

finding.title: Incorrect Embedder Instantiation in Test
finding.description: The test instantiates `DummyEmbedder` with `AIConfig(provider="custom", ollama_urls=[])` and `valkey_client=None`. However, the `DummyEmbedder` class does not accept these parameters in its constructor. This will cause a TypeError when the test runs because the constructor signature doesn't match what's being called.

finding.title: Incorrect assertion in exception masking test
finding.description: The test `test_span_handle_record_exception_masks_secrets` contains a logical contradiction in its assertions. Lines 114-115 assert that `<masked-github-token>` is NOT in the exception message, but then immediately assert that it IS in the same field. This creates a false positive condition that passes even when the masking logic is broken. The second assertion should be checking that the token is present in the message (to verify it was captured) but the first assertion should be checking that it's absent from the final logged data.

verification_criteria.description: Execute the test function directly to verify it fails with incorrect logic

invalidation_criteria.description: Verify that the actual implementation properly masks tokens in both message and stacktrace fields
